libraryPreparationPreflight.agent_guidance: Keep the existing FixedResourceProvider approach (hardcoded migration resource list) rather than relying on classpath resource enumeration, since GraalVM Native Image cannot enumerate classpath resources generically. Start the mssql/server container on 1433/tcp with ACCEPT_EULA=Y and a fixed SA password, poll until a JDBC connection succeeds (Awaitility, as in the current test) before invoking Flyway.migrate(), and tear the container process down in an @AfterAll. Run the migration through SQLServerDataSource against the two existing V1/V2 SQL migration resources and assert migrationsExecuted == 2. Note: the issue's reproducer command references coordinates=org.flywaydb:flyway-sqlserver:12.3.0 while the title/body target 13.5.0 — treat 13.5.0 as the authoritative target coordinate for local Gradle/Native Image verification.

deterministic_setup.reason: flyway-sqlserver does not bundle a JDBC driver (verified in its 13.5.0 POM); Flyway's own docs require a driver to be supplied separately, and the repository already trusts this exact driver version for this test.

Meaningful migration coverage requires a real SQL Server instance; reuse the exact tag already pinned under tests/tck-build-logic/.../Dockerfile-mssql_server rather than introducing a new allow-list entry.
